primer: Lowe's Companies (NYSE: LOW) is America's #2 home-improvement retailer with 1,759 US stores (~89% owned) and $86,286M in audited FY2025 sales. Strong free cash flow ($7,651M; 115% of net income) and 26.1% audited ROIC earn a price-blind COMPOUNDER_PASS. At $231.04 (18.17x forward P/E; 6.17% FCF yield), shares trade well below Home Depot and support a $268.00 Base Target, but sit extended +13.6% above the 50-day SMA in a Downtrend tape. We hold 0 shares (NOT_HELD), assign new capital WAIT_FOR_SUPPORT (TIER_2) at $211.18–$223.49 ($200.00 stop), and keep 100% of marginal cash in T-bills.
